description: This file defines the base class MathIllegalArgumentException, which represents exceptions related to illegal argument errors in the Apache Commons Math library. It extends IllegalArgumentException and includes contextual information for error messages.
external_methods: Problematic class and interface methods such as getContext()

classes.name: MathIllegalArgumentException
classes.description: A base exception class for invalid argument errors, carrying contextual information and message localization support.

methods.name: MathIllegalArgumentException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a pattern and arguments for the error message.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the exception context containing message details.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Overrides the default getMessage() to return the context's message.

methods.name: getLocalizedMessage
methods.description: Overrides the default toLocalizedMessage() to return localized message from context.
